private.owned_ai_expiry_due:
select exists(select 1 from private.owned_ai_operation_dispositions d left join private.owned_ai_deletion_dispositions a on a.owner_id=d.owner_id
  where d.owner_id=p_owner and d.kind=p_kind and d.operation_id=p_operation and d.analysis_id is not distinct from p_analysis
   and (d.phase='repair_required' or least(d.expires_at,a.expires_at)<=clock_timestamp()))
  or exists(select 1 from private.owned_ai_deletion_dispositions a where a.owner_id=p_owner and a.expires_at<=clock_timestamp());
private.owned_ai_expiry_selected:
select exists(select 1 from private.owned_ai_expiry_work w where w.transaction_id=txid_current() and w.owner_id=p_owner and w.kind=p_kind
  and (p_kind='r03' or nullif(w.identity->>'analysisId','')::uuid is not distinct from p_analysis)
  and nullif(w.identity->>'operationId','')::uuid is not distinct from p_operation
  and nullif(w.identity->>'runId','')::uuid is not distinct from p_run and w.expires_at<=clock_timestamp());
private.owned_ai_expiry_catalogue:
select jsonb_object_agg(c.relname,jsonb_build_object(
  'columns',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'notNull',a.attnotnull,
    'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated,'default',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid)) order by a.attnum)
    from pg_catalog.pg_attribute a left join pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=a.attrelid and d.adnum=a.attnum
    where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped),
  'constraints',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',k.conname,'type',k.contype,'validated',k.convalidated,
    'deferred',k.condeferred,'deferrable',k.condeferrable,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,false)) order by k.conname),'[]'::jsonb)
    from pg_catalog.pg_constraint k where k.conrelid=c.oid),
  'indexes',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',i.relname,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(x.indexrelid),
    'unique',x.indisunique,'primary',x.indisprimary,'valid',x.indisvalid,'nullsNotDistinct',x.indnullsnotdistinct,
    'keys',x.indkey::text,'predicate',pg_get_expr(x.indpred,x.indrelid)) order by i.relname),'[]'::jsonb)
    from pg_catalog.pg_index x join pg_catalog.pg_class i on i.oid=x.indexrelid where x.indrelid=c.oid),
  'triggers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'type',t.tgtype,
    'args',encode(t.tgargs,'hex'),'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,false)) order by t.tgname),'[]'::jsonb)
    from pg_catalog.pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid=c.oid and not t.tgisinternal
     and not (c.relname='owned_ai_expiry_catalogue_seal' and t.tgname='owned_ai_expiry_seal_closed'))))
 from pg_catalog.pg_class c where c.oid in ('private.owned_ai_expiry_months'::regclass,'private.owned_ai_expiry_work'::regclass,'private.owned_ai_expiry_adoption_capability'::regclass,'private.owned_ai_expiry_catalogue_seal'::regclass);
